name: MCG +03-28-022, SN 1988Z field (Hubble)
blurb: MCG +03-28-022, a galaxy that hosted the supernova SN 1988Z, seen by Hubble.
label: sn1988z-hubble
story: Here SN 1988Z, a Type IIn supernova, blazed as its shock slammed into shells of gas the doomed star had cast off, likely a very massive star. Hubble returned to the site long afterward to see what light still lingers.

claims.text: SN 1988Z was discovered in MCG +03-28-022, also called Zw 095-049
SN 1988Z is a Type IIn supernova
Its shock interacted strongly with a circumstellar shell
It arose from a very massive star
Hubble program 13029 imaged the site to obtain late-time photometry
